chapters.label: The pass, live
chapters.text: El Sadar, Pamplona, October 1993. Osasuna against Barcelona. Laudrup has the ball, and no gap to pass through. He looks at the crowd... but scoops it over the defence! Romário lobs the keeper. Goal!

chapters.label: Watch his eyes
chapters.text: Watch his eyes. Laudrup looks to the side, but his foot lifts the ball forward, like a spoon. His famous no-look pass!

chapters.label: Over the top
chapters.text: No space along the grass, so the ball flies over the top. Romário runs in and chips keeper Unanua.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: look one way and pass the other, to fool the defenders!
